title: The Quintessential Quintuplets Title Screen
description: A hastily and crappily made resource pack. Changes the title screen to be TQQ themed.
body:
A resource pack that changes the title screen to be themed around The Quintessential Quintuplets.

CHANGES:
- Background is now the combined covers of volumes 7-11.
- Title is now white.
- Buttons are now blue (because Miku is my favorite quint).
